$Comment: Ice ray rune: casts the Ice King's own ice ray (Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Ray: ice damage + a frost stack). Costs 30 mana like a vanilla rune; its cast first needs 30 ice magic (stat AT_Ice_Magic), which only the Ice King crown gives, so it only works while you wear it (Ability.CostType is a fixed list, a mod stat is refused there). Structure of vanilla Rune_Fireball; placeholder look: the blank vanilla rune. No recipe yet.
